cohort_total_n_excerpt: We examined the association between alcohol use and prostate cancer among 34,565 men, 50-76 yr old, in the Vitamins and Lifestyle (VITAL) cohort in Washington State.
reason: The prospective cohort evaluated incident prostate cancer overall. The abstract does not report an analysis of aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Men who consumed more than one drink per month had a small increased risk of prostate cancer (hazard ratio, HR = 1.20; 95% confidence interval, CI = 1.02-1.40) compared with men who drank no alcohol or less than one drink per month.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported HR is for overall incident prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype.
